chunks: Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
“A woman performs salat (prayer) in a dirʿ and a miqnaʿah if it is thick, meaning concealing.”

key_terms.الدِّرْعِ: a dress or long garment worn by a woman
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman; the subject of the ruling regarding salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: What clothing is sufficient for a woman’s salat (prayer) according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a woman’s dress in salat (prayer), stating that praying in a dirʿ and a miqnaʿah is sufficient when the garment is thick and concealing. Its significance lies in clarifying the condition of proper covering for women in prayer within Shia fiqh.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1081 - Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:
"A woman prays in a dress (dir'aa) and a head covering (miqna'a) if it is thick, meaning it is concealing."
